data.one_liner: Shows iOS App Tracking Transparency dialog and retrieves the advertising identifier.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter API to request user consent for tracking on iOS 14+ and to obtain the IDFA. Handles platform-specific setup and status checks.
use_when: You need to comply with iOS ATT requirements for ad revenue.
You want to access the advertising identifier after user consent.
avoid_when: Your app targets only Android or other platforms.
You already use another permission plugin that covers ATT.
strengths: Supports both Swift Package Manager and CocoaPods.
data.setup_notes: Add NSUserTrackingUsageDescription to ios/Runner/Info.plist; ensure Xcode 12+; optionally add SKAdNetworkItems per Google docs.

alternatives.name: permission_handler
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a unified permission API for iOS, Android and other platforms, including ATT.
